Compare edge-covariate and independent-layers SBM variants

compare_layered_models.Rd

Declarative, callback-free model selection between the discrete edge-covariate layered SBM (independent = FALSE) and the conditionally independent layers SBM (independent = TRUE), optionally across degree-corrected and non-degree-corrected variants and using either MAP description lengths or full Bayesian posterior marginal evidence.

Usage

compare_layered_models(graph, layers,
  models = c("edge_covariates", "independent_layers"), nested = TRUE,
  degree_corrected = TRUE, degree_prior = c("distributed", "uniform"),
  method = c("map", "posterior"),
  evidence_method = c("variational", "importance"), nruns = 1L,
  nsamples = 200L, thin = 5L, burnin = NULL, mle = TRUE, B_min = 1L,
  B_max = Inf, refine = TRUE)

Arguments

graph

A graph created by graph_create.

layers

Discrete edge layer labels: an edge property name or a vector of length graph_num_edges(graph).

models

Character vector naming a subset of "edge_covariates", "independent_layers", "edge_covariates_dc", "edge_covariates_ndc", "independent_layers_dc", and "independent_layers_ndc". The unqualified names use degree_corrected.

nested

Whether to fit nested (TRUE, default) or flat (FALSE) layered SBMs.

degree_corrected

Degree correction setting used for "edge_covariates" and "independent_layers".

degree_prior

Degree sequence hyperprior ("distributed" or "uniform").

method

Rank candidate models by "map" minimum description length or full Bayesian "posterior" marginal evidence.

evidence_method

Evidence estimator forwarded to model_evidence when method = "posterior".

nruns

Number of independent minimization restarts per candidate.

nsamples, thin, burnin, mle

Posterior sampling arguments used when method = "posterior".

B_min, B_max

Bounds on the number of level-0 groups.

refine

Whether to run local refinement sweeps during minimization.

Value

A rgraphtool_layered_model_comparison list containing:

  • summary: ranked data frame with model, independent, degree_corrected, B, description_length, posterior_entropy, neg_log_evidence, delta, and posterior_weight.

  • best_model: name of the winning layered model.

  • best_state: fitted layered state for the winning model.

  • states: named list of fitted states ordered from best to worst.

  • evidences: named list of rgraphtool_model_evidence objects (when method = "posterior").

  • log_bayes_factors: pairwise matrix of log Bayes factors.

References

Peixoto, T. P. (2015). Inferring the mesoscale structure of layered, edge-valued, and time-varying networks. Physical Review E 92, 042807.

See also

layered_block_state, model_evidence, demo("layered_sbm")

Examples

set.seed(42)
g <- graph_create(12, directed = FALSE)
edges <- rbind(t(utils::combn(1:6, 2)), t(utils::combn(7:12, 2)))
lay <- c(rep("layer_a", 15), rep("layer_b", 15))
graph_add_edges(g, edges)
cmp <- compare_layered_models(g, layers = lay, nested = FALSE)
cmp
#> <layered SBM model comparison (flat, 2 layers, MAP)>
#>               model B description_length  delta posterior_weight
#>  independent_layers 1             36.415  0.000          1.0e+00
#>     edge_covariates 2             54.368 17.953          1.6e-08
#> Best layered model: independent_layers
